name: zerovc-client
description: Ultra-fast, lightweight voice and text communication platform built with Electron and LiveKit WebRTC

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const copyDir=(src,dest)=>{ if(!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true}); for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(src,{withFileTypes:true})){ const s=path.join(src,entry.name),d=path.join(dest,entry.name); if(entry.name==='downloads') continue; if(entry.isDirectory()){ copyDir(s,d); } else { fs.copyFileSync(s,d); } } }; if(fs.existsSync('../backend/web/assets')){ const cur=new Set(fs.readdirSync('dist/assets')); for(const f of fs.readdirSync('../backend/web/assets')){ if(!cur.has(f) && f!=='minecraft.webp') try { fs.unlinkSync(path.join('../backend/web/assets',f)); } catch{} } } copyDir('dist','../backend/web');"
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['icon.ico','icon.png','tray-icon.png'].forEach(f=>{ if(fs.existsSync('electron/'+f)) fs.copyFileSync('electron/'+f, 'dist-electron/'+f); }); if(fs.existsSync('electron/bin')){ if(!fs.existsSync('dist-electron/bin')) fs.mkdirSync('dist-electron/bin', {recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync('electron/bin').forEach(f=> fs.copyFileSync('electron/bin/'+f, 'dist-electron/bin/'+f)); }"
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win nsis && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='../backend/web/downloads/';fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});['ZeroVC-Setup.exe','ZeroVC-Setup.exe.blockmap','latest.yml'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync('release/'+f))fs.copyFileSync('release/'+f,d+f);});"
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
